input: Research Boeing (boeing.com) for a hedge fund

catalysts.claim: As of 2026-11-09, SPEEA has scheduled a November 19 meeting with Boeing leadership about the commercial-airplane layoffs; details could clarify execution risks and restructuring scope.
As of 2026-10-27, Boeing plans its next 787 production increase beyond eight aircraft/month to begin in December 2026.
As of 2026-10-27, Boeing expects authorization for the final phases of 777X certification flight testing by year-end 2026; this is not final aircraft certification.
As of 2026-10-27, prebuilt 737-7 and 737-10 aircraft are expected to start delivering in early 2027, providing a test of inventory monetization after certification.

results_vs_guidance.claim: For the quarter ended 2026-09-30, reported October 27: revenue $24.188 billion, GAAP loss/share $0.26, core loss/share $0.34, operating cash flow $1.496 billion and free cash flow $464 million.
As of 2026-10-27, quarterly core loss/share of $0.34 missed the $0.21 loss expected in LSEG's consensus cited by Reuters.
As of 2026-10-27, Investing.com reported quarterly revenue of $24.19 billion against its quoted $24.39 billion estimate, a revenue miss.

The pre-quarter benchmark, issued 2026-07-28, was positive third-quarter free cash flow in the low hundreds of millions after an approximately $700 million DOJ payment; full-year guidance was $1 billion–$3 billion.
Current management outlook as of 2026-10-27: approximately $2 billion free cash flow in 2026, $3 billion in 2027, $6 billion in 2028 and $10 billion in 2029.
As of 2026-10-27, Reuters reported the $3 billion 2027 free-cash-flow outlook versus $5.5 billion consensus; management's $10 billion milestone was a year later than investor consensus.
As of 2026-10-27, management expects to miss the 2026 target of 500 737 deliveries; 787 deliveries remain guided to 90–100, nearer the lower end.

event_driven.claim: Boeing completed the Spirit AeroSystems acquisition on 2025-12-08, bringing Boeing-related fuselages and major structures in-house. This is a completed integration story, not a pending merger-arbitrage catalyst.
For the quarter ended 2026-09-30, Boeing recognized a $252 million gain from selling its HRL Laboratories investment.
For the quarter ended 2026-09-30, Boeing made no open-market program repurchases; 25,949 employee shares received were tax-withholding transfers, not discretionary buybacks.

credit_signals.claim: As of 2026-09-30, cash and marketable securities totaled $20.7 billion; another $10 billion of revolving facilities remained undrawn.
As of 2026-09-30, total debt was $45.9 billion, including $4.6 billion classified as short-term.

The maturity schedule as of 2025-12-31 showed debt/other-note principal payments of $4.403 billion in 2027 and $2.739 billion in 2028; these are historical scheduled amounts, not a refreshed maturity forecast.
On 2026-08-24, Boeing renewed its $3 billion revolver through August 23, 2027 and extended the $3 billion and $4 billion facilities through August 24, 2029 and May 15, 2030, respectively.

Under the agreement dated 2026-08-24, minimum liquidity is $5 billion; consolidated debt cannot exceed 60% of contract-defined total capital. Definitions and historical adjustments mean this is not a simple GAAP balance-sheet ratio.
As reported 2026-10-27: Fitch BBB-/positive, following June's outlook improvement; S&P BBB-/stable; Moody's Baa3/stable. Boeing reported compliance with its debt and credit-facility covenants.

alternative_signals.claim: As of 2026-11-09, Boeing Commercial Airplanes plans a 5% workforce reduction through attrition and involuntary layoffs; notices begin in December at the earliest. Management attributed overstaffing to slower production ramps.
On 2026-11-04, Avolon finalized an order for 140 Boeing 737-10s. Boeing reported lessor firm orders exceeding 230 aircraft for this variant during 2026.

Aviation Week reported on 2026-11-04 that Avolon's announcement selected the variant for its October commitment, rather than representing an entirely incremental commitment; EASA validation was still underway.

On 2026-10-05, Boeing disclosed an approximately $14.7 billion, seven-year undefinitized PAC-3 MSE seeker contract action from Lockheed Martin; associated hiring had begun, with hundreds of regional jobs expected.
The FAA certified the 737 MAX-10 on 2026-10-20 and approved production, removing a regulatory prerequisite to deliveries; certification should not be treated as an upcoming catalyst.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Director Mortimer J. Buckley purchased 5,820 shares at $171.55 on 2026-10-30, leaving 10,250 directly owned shares; the Form 4 was filed November 3.
Director Steven M. Mollenkopf purchased 2,950 shares on 2026-10-30 at a weighted-average $173.026, leaving 6,717 directly owned shares; the Form 4 was filed November 3.

Capital World Investors' May 14 filing reported 41,497,786 beneficially owned shares, or 5.2%, as of 2026-03-31. The total includes 15,370,300 common-share equivalents from convertible preferred securities.
Appaloosa's quarterly disclosure reported 800,000 Boeing common shares valued at $173,176,000 as of 2026-06-30. This establishes a historical position, not its current holding or purchase cost.

risks.claim: Execution could disappoint again: as of 2026-11-09, Boeing expected stable 737 output of 47/month only in early 2027, versus its earlier summer-2026 expectation, while cutting commercial staffing.
As of 2026-10-27, key-supplier shortages were expected to disrupt 777 factory operations through first-half 2027, generating abnormal production costs expensed as incurred.

Cash-flow delivery is assumption-sensitive: as of 2026-10-27, the annual outlook included a KC-46A Lot 13 order/advance and seasonal working-capital benefits; the financial plan assumed 777X certification by mid-2027.
Reported defense improvement overstates recurring earnings: for the quarter ended 2026-09-30, BDS operating earnings of $492 million included the $252 million HRL sale gain.

Commercial profitability remains fragile: for the quarter ended 2026-09-30, BCA lost $697 million with a negative 6.5% margin, reflecting delivery mix, production-rate adjustments and higher estimated supplier costs.

Civil securities exposure remains a separate risk from the criminal settlement: the March 16, 2026 district-court order certified an investor class in the MAX litigation. No future decision date was verified.

output.research_view: As of 2026-11-10, my view is cautious: the staffing reset reinforces the inference that execution, rather than order demand, is the immediate constraint (source_url: https://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Boeing%2Bto%2Bcut%2B5%25%2Bof%2Bcommercial%2Bjet%2Bworkforce%C2%A0amid%2Bproduction%2Bstruggles/27313782.html; date: 2026-11-09). I would prioritize stable factory output and repeatable cash conversion over backlog headlines, particularly after management's cash-flow outlook fell below consensus (source_url: https://ca.marketscreener.com/news/boeing-jetliner-production-challenges-weigh-on-third-quarter-results-ce785cddda8bf324; date: 2026-10-27).

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
